== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The Miners are a small, specialized order within the [[Consultants]], consisting of only forty-two students. They serve as the organization's archivists, tasked with the meticulous preservation and sorting of all [[Consultant]] records to ensure that no information is ever lost. Due to their access to sensitive personnel files for [[Gray Island]], members of this order are bound by strict oaths of secrecy. As part of the [[Consultants' Guild|Consultant Guild]], they are characterized by a disciplined nature, typically following orders precisely and remaining silent unless required by their duties. While the term can refer to laborers performing manual tasks like digging or hauling, in a technical context, it describes individuals who use specialized equipment to harvest [[aura]] from thick environments, a process that is highly dangerous and often results in significant casualties.}}
